reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web personal workbench centered on calendar-based task planning, hierarchical execution workflows, AI-assisted task management, reminders, and local knowledge capture.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供日历、层级任务、AI 辅助规划执行、提醒和本地知识管理的个人工作台。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web personal workbench for calendar-based tasks, AI-assisted planning and execution, reminders, and local knowledge management.

capabilities: Manages hierarchical tasks, calendars, reminders, recurring tasks, and archives
Uses configured AI models for clarification, consultation, task decomposition, execution, prioritization, reporting, and review
Reads selected local documents for AI-generated knowledge drafts and stores local task data in SQLite and JSON files
Can initiate execution workflows that may modify workspace files and consume configured API tokens
Can display browser and system notifications for task due dates
